summary: Constructor for a fixed-size element container. Computes an element count v3 = (a2 == 0) ? 2 : 0, allocates 1016 * v3 + 4 bytes via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper, stores the count into the 4-byte header dword, then runs DualCallWrapper_4f50 over each 1016-byte element as an initializer. On success *this receives the element-array pointer (header + 1); on allocation failure *this is set to 0. The prelabel cluster marks it a structural twin of ObjectAllocator. Subsystem: ai. Not on the per-frame path.

operations.description: Select the element count: v3 = 2 when a2 is zero, otherwise v3 = 0.
Allocate 1016 * v3 + 4 bytes through OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper (0x00587C03): 4 header bytes plus v3 elements of 1016 bytes each.
If the allocation succeeded, store the element count v3 into the header dword *v4 and set the element-array pointer to v4 + 1.
Run DualCallWrapper_4f50 (0x004B4F50) on each element pointer v6, advancing by the 1016-byte stride and counting down until all v3 elements are initialized.
On the success path store the element-array pointer into the container field at this+0x00.
On allocation failure set the container field at this+0x00 to the init literal 0.
Return the container pointer this on both the success and the failure paths.
Called by VehicleInstanceListBuilder (0x004B5C50) to construct the fixed-size vehicle element container.

unresolved: Element type and meaning of the 1016-byte element stride are unknown; DualCallWrapper_4f50 is an element initializer whose exact contract is not established.
Why the count is 2 when a2 == 0 and 0 otherwise is caller-dependent (a2 may select between a populated and an empty container).
Owner class of the container is unknown (packet owner trust UNKNOWN).
